hooks.command: filepath="$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE '"file_path":\s*"[^"]+"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*"file_path":\s*"//;s/"$//')"; echo "$filepath" | grep -qE 'server/(data|certs|uploads)/|\.env$' && echo 'BLOCKED: Cannot edit production-only files (server/data, server/certs, server/.env, server/uploads)' && exit 1 || exit 0
